about.title: Who I am and what I'm after
about.quote: I like to contribute meaningfully to the teams and projects I'm part of — always trying to make the work easier, improve processes, and find practical solutions.
about.bio_lead: I'm Jesús Martínez — a Mexican data analyst and IT technician with four years of work split between Oracle consulting, infrastructure support, and analysis in the public sector.
about.bio_p1: I started as a technical consultant, training profiles on Oracle databases. From there I moved into infrastructure support — workstations, networks, and CCTV for various companies. The pivotal shift came when I joined the public sector: first as a reimbursements analyst at IMSS-Bienestar, and now in HR at the Mexico State Water Commission, where I automate payroll processes, recover a full year of tax-stamping operations, and build internal tools for the area.
about.bio_p2: The next step is to model, not just report. That's why I'm pursuing a Data Science Engineering degree at UNITEC and using this portfolio to publish every formative project: from my first classification model to my first reproducible dashboard on public data.
about.bio_p3: What I'm after: teams that make decisions with data, real operational problems — public or private — and projects where I can turn information into concrete action.

churn.title: Customer churn prediction
churn.description: Binary classifier that flags customers at risk of leaving, trained on historical behaviour data.
churn.long: Reproducible pipeline that ingests transactional and usage data, derives recent-activity features, and trains supervised models to predict churn probability within a 90-day horizon.

detail.problem: Cut customer churn by flagging risky accounts before they leave, so retention actions can land in time.
detail.data: Anonymised historical customer table with usage logs, tickets, tenure and billing events. Time-based train/validation split.
detail.approach: Feature engineering (RFM, weekly deltas), comparison between logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost with stratified validation.
detail.results: Pending. Precision, recall, F1 and the PR curve will be reported on the test window against a simple-rule baseline.
detail.next: Bring in external signals (NPS, seasonality) and experiment with probability calibration.

nlp_news.title: Topic classification for Spanish news
nlp_news.description: NLP pipeline that tags news into politics, economy, sports, and culture using embeddings plus a supervised classifier.
nlp_news.long: Multi-class classifier for Spanish-language news streams: preprocessing, pretrained embeddings, and a supervised model — with explicit focus on interpretability and performance on imbalanced classes.

detail.problem: Automatically tag each news item with a topic to enable aggregation, search and coverage analysis.
detail.data: Spanish news corpus with topic labels (politics, economy, sports, culture). Tokenisation, lemmatisation and entity cleaning included.
detail.approach: Multilingual transformer embeddings + supervised classifier (logreg / linear SVM). Evaluation with precision, recall and macro-F1.
detail.results: Pending. Will include confusion matrix and a qualitative review per category.
detail.next: Try lightweight transformer fine-tuning and extend to additional categories (tech, health, opinion).

dashboard_nomina.title: Government payroll dashboard
dashboard_nomina.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard with KPIs around stamping, withholdings, and reimbursements — sensitive data anonymized.
dashboard_nomina.long: Executive dashboard consolidating payroll operations: stamping volume, withholdings, processing errors and reimbursements. All sensitive data is anonymised before ingestion.

detail.problem: Bring scattered payroll KPIs into one place and cut response time on internal audits.
detail.data: Internal payroll and stamping tables, anonymised via identifier tokenisation. Daily cadence.
detail.approach: Star schema with event fact tables, time and entity dimensions. DAX measures and area slicers.
detail.results: Pending. A public version with representative synthetic data will be shared.
detail.next: Threshold alerts and a scheduled PDF export for weekly review.

viz_demografia.title: Interactive demographic atlas of Mexico
viz_demografia.description: Web visualization with D3 that cross-references INEGI data by state and municipality to explore population patterns.
viz_demografia.long: Interactive exploration of the Mexican census: choropleth map at the municipality level with switchable variables (population, density, median age), historic comparison and a national-figures sidebar.

detail.problem: Make INEGI data accessible to non-technical users — comparing states and municipalities without wading through large tables.
detail.data: National Population and Housing Census, INEGI. Simplified TopoJSON geometry for the web.
detail.approach: Render with D3 + TypeScript, perceptually uniform palettes (viridis / cividis), hover and filter interactions.
detail.results: Pending. Load time and LCP on mid-range devices will be measured.
detail.next: Add historic series and comparison with intercensal surveys.

automation_cfdi.title: Bulk CFDI dispatch pipeline
automation_cfdi.description: Refactor of my statewide CFDI mailer into a reproducible pipeline with logging, retries, and address validation.
automation_cfdi.long: Refactor of the current bulk-CFDI mailing job: idempotent tasks, recipient validation, error handling and per-batch traceability.

detail.problem: The current monolithic script isn't reproducible or auditable; SMTP failures get lost and there is no controlled retry.
detail.data: Recipient catalogue and email templates. Upfront validation via regex and domain checks.
detail.approach: Modular pipeline with an in-process queue, bounded exponential retries, structured logging and unit tests.
detail.results: Pending. Delivery rate, bounces and batch duration will be reported.
detail.next: Move to an orchestrator (Prefect / Airflow) and add a monitoring panel.

rec_books.title: Technical-book recommender
rec_books.description: Hybrid content-based + collaborative recommender built on public Goodreads data.
rec_books.long: Hybrid recommender for technical books: content similarity (descriptions, tags) combined with rating-based collaborative filtering, with a focus on explaining each suggestion.

detail.problem: Suggest relevant technical reads from a handful of known books — without collapsing into popularity bubbles.
detail.data: Public Goodreads subset with metadata, ratings and reviews. Filtered to technical categories.
detail.approach: Hybrid model: TF-IDF / embedding vectors of descriptions + matrix factorisation. Hit@10 and MRR on a time-based split.
detail.results: Pending. Will include comparison against popularity-only recommendations.
detail.next: Add diversity control and explicit filters by level and difficulty.
